metric_to_log.label: Metric to Log
metric_to_log.hint: Convert a metric event into a log event, which can be useful for sending metrics to log-support downstream components.

collectors.label: Collectors
collectors.hint: The list of host metric collector services to use. Defaults to all collectors.

namespace.label: Namespace
namespace.hint: Overrides the default namespace for the metrics emitted by the source.

scrape_interval_secs.label: Scrape Interval Secs
scrape_interval_secs.hint: The interval between metric gathering, in seconds.

cgroups.base.label: Cgroups Base
cgroups.base.hint: The base cgroup name to provide metrics for.

cgroups.groups.excludes.label: Cgroups Groups Excludes
cgroups.groups.excludes.hint: CSV list of cgroup name patterns to exclude in gathering usage metrics.

cgroups.groups.includes.label: Cgroups Groups Includes
cgroups.groups.includes.hint: CSV list of cgroup name patterns to include in gathering usage metrics.

cgroups.levels.label: Cgroups Levels
cgroups.levels.hint: The number of levels of the cgroups hierarchy for which to report metrics. A value of 1 means the root or named cgroup.

disk.devices.excludes.label: Disk Devices Excludes
disk.devices.excludes.hint: CSV list of device name patterns to exclude in gathering I/O utilization metrics.

disk.devices.includes.label: Disk Devices Includes
disk.devices.includes.hint: CSV list of device name patterns to include in gathering I/O utilization metrics.

filesystem.devices.excludes.label: Filesystem Devices Excludes
filesystem.devices.excludes.hint: CSV list of device name patterns to exclude in gathering usage metrics.

filesystem.devices.includes.label: Filesystem Devices Includes
filesystem.devices.includes.hint: CSV list of device name patterns to include in gathering usage metrics.

filesystem.filesystems.excludes.label: Filesystem Filesystems Excludes
filesystem.filesystems.excludes.hint: CSV list of filesystem name patterns to exclude in gathering usage metrics.

filesystem.filesystems.includes.label: Filesystem Filesystems Includes
filesystem.filesystems.includes.hint: CSV list of filesystem name patterns to include in gathering usage metrics.

filesystem.mountpoints.excludes.label: Filesystem Mountpoints Excludes
filesystem.mountpoints.excludes.hint: CSV list of mount point path patterns to exclude in gathering usage metrics.

filesystem.mountpoints.includes.label: Filesystem Mountpoints Includes
filesystem.mountpoints.includes.hint: CSV list of mount point path patterns to include in gathering usage metrics.

network.devices.excludes.label: Network Devices Excludes
network.devices.excludes.hint: CSV list of device name patterns to exclude in gathering network utilization metrics.

network.devices.includes.label: Network Devices Includes
network.devices.includes.hint: CSV list of device name patterns to include in gathering network utilization metrics.

process.processes.excludes.label: Process Processes Excludes
process.processes.excludes.hint: CSV list of process name patterns to exclude.

process.processes.includes.label: Process Processes Includes
process.processes.includes.hint: CSV list of process name patterns to include.
